name: Minami no Shima ni Furu Yuki
source:
Endless blue sky and the shining sun.... There is a small southern island. Ryou and Kanade are childhood friends, who have grown up on the island. They are like brother and sister, but Ryou gradually starts to love Kanade. One day, he tells her that he loves her. But she says, "I'm leaving this island after graduating high school, and never coming back." When he is depressed, he meets a beautiful girl, Saina. According to her, she is a legendary princess of the island. She asks him to get back the special coral to break the seal. He is skeptical at first, but she tells him that she will make his wish come true, if he breaks her seal. He finally accepts it because he doesn't want to separate from Kanade.... When he wakes up, he finds himself lying in front of a small shrine. It seems nothing has changed.... It must have been a dream.... But he finds her kiss mark on his index finger....

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070513232150/http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/6834]Himeya Shop[/url]]
translation:
无尽的蓝天与耀眼的阳光之下，有一座南方小岛。亮与奏是从小在岛上长大的青梅竹马，感情如同兄妹，但亮渐渐爱上了奏。一天，他向她告白，奏却回答：“高中毕业后我就会离开这座岛，再也不回来。”亮因此陷入消沉，并在此时遇见美丽少女赛娜。据她所说，自己是岛上传说中的公主。她请求亮取回特殊珊瑚，解除身上的封印。亮起初半信半疑，但赛娜告诉他，只要解除封印，她就会实现他的愿望。因为不愿与奏分离，亮最终答应了……醒来时，他发现自己躺在一座小神社前。四周似乎毫无变化……刚才一定只是一场梦……然而，他的食指上却留着她的吻痕……
